chief_complaint: Acute chest heaviness and breathlessness on climbing stairs
history_of_present_illness: Patient reports progressive exertional retrosternal discomfort since 3 days.
examination_findings: BP elevated, S1 S2 normal, no murmurs. Lungs clear.
assessment_plan: Stable angina evaluation. Order Troponin-I and ECG.

chief_complaint: High grade fever with chills and dry cough since 4 days
history_of_present_illness: Fever spiking up to 102 F in evenings, associated with body ache and sore throat.
examination_findings: Pharyngeal congestion present. Chest bilateral vesicular breath sounds.
assessment_plan: Acute upper respiratory tract infection. Paracetamol and CBC ordered.

chief_complaint: Uncontrolled blood sugar readings and frequent urination
history_of_present_illness: Patient monitoring FBS > 210 mg/dL, Polyuria and polydipsia noted over 2 weeks.
examination_findings: BMI 29.4, bilateral pedal edema absent. Foot exam normal.
assessment_plan: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus with sub-optimal glycemic control. Adjust Metformin.

chief_complaint: Severe pain and swelling in right knee joint after morning walk
history_of_present_illness: Unable to bear weight comfortably, pain aggravating on stairs.
examination_findings: Right knee effusion present, tenderness along medial joint line, range of motion restricted.
assessment_plan: Acute flare of osteoarthritis right knee. Order X-ray Right Knee.

chief_complaint: Persistent throbbing headache and blurred vision since yesterday
history_of_present_illness: Occipital headache awakening patient from sleep, mild nausea.
examination_findings: Marked hypertension (175/105 mmHg). Fundoscopy: Grade 1 hypertensive changes.
assessment_plan: Hypertensive Urgency. Immediate antihypertensive titration. CDS alert triggered.

chief_complaint: Chronic acidity, epigastric burning and retrosternal distress
history_of_present_illness: Postprandial heartburn and acid regurgitation worse in recumbent posture.

assessment_plan: Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD) with reflux gastritis. Start PPI.
